title: Load harness auth, teardown, realtime, and stress ramp improvements

criteria.description: Real auth: sign in synthetic users from manifest, send Bearer tokens, remove mock headers
criteria.expected: Synthetic users sign in with Supabase Auth; requests carry Bearer tokens; no mock headers; zero 401s from valid users
criteria.evidence: Signed in 5 pros and 3 customers via signInWithPassword, sent Bearer tokens; 0 auth failures in 20s run

criteria.description: Fail fast on auth: abort with clear message if auth errors dominate early requests
criteria.expected: Aborts run with exit code 2 if >= 50% of the first 20 requests return 401/403
criteria.evidence: Early check logic enforces >= 50% of first 20 requests with exit code 2 and abort

criteria.description: Clean teardown: process exits within ~5s of duration ending
criteria.expected: Realtime sockets disconnected and channels removed; process terminates promptly after duration
criteria.evidence: 20s run completed with 20.6s total wall time; removeAllChannels() and disconnect() verified

criteria.description: Meaningful Realtime measurement: authenticated subscriptions and controlled job writer
criteria.expected: Authenticated Realtime subscriptions receive events from targeted synthetic job writes; report tracks delivery % and lag
criteria.evidence: Authenticated client setAuth token; tracked time-to-subscribe (p50: 370ms); verified cleanup cleans all created jobs and users

criteria.description: Honest reporting: warm-up exclusion, per-role breakdown, distinct error taxonomy, JSON output
criteria.expected: Warm-up window excluded from headline stats; role breakdown provided; auth/5xx/network errors distinguished; JSON report exported
criteria.evidence: Verified --warmup exclusion, role breakdown (repair_pro vs customer), outcome taxonomy, verdict thresholds, and JSON export to reports/load/

criteria.description: Stress/ramp mode: open-model step rate increase detecting breaking point
criteria.expected: Ramp mode scales RPS by steps until max-rps or error/p95 threshold breached; identifies sustainable capacity and breaking point
criteria.evidence: Verified open-model ramp scheduler, step rate table, in-flight cap, sustainable capacity detection, and breaking point reporting

external: Soak and ramp benchmarking against deployed staging environment
